candidate_sentence_map.S11: The lower net profit compared to 2024 was primarily attributable to one-off effects related to the initial consolidation of Tallink Grupp recognized in the prior year.

candidate_sentence_map.S19: Overall, the group demonstrated stable operational performance and strengthened its balance sheet resilience despite an economic environment marked by geopolitical tensions and uneven market cycles.

Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization reached 232,581 thousand euros, up from 145,415 thousand euros in 2024, yielding an EBITDA margin of 13.4% compared to 10.6% previously.

Net profit for the financial year was 71,969 thousand euros, down from 193,670 thousand euros reported in 2024, with net profit attributable to the owners of the parent amounting to 72,662 thousand euros compared to 191,253 thousand euros in the prior year.
The lower net profit compared to 2024 was primarily attributable to one-off effects related to the initial consolidation of Tallink Grupp recognized in the prior year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 revenue was EUR 417.4 million and EBITDA EUR 42.6 million, with net profit turning positive at EUR 14.1 million compared to a loss of EUR 11.9 million in Q4 2024.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025 table (Q4 2025 vs Q4 2024 columns for revenue, EBITDA, and net profit); Events in Q4 2025 section lists factors impacting Q4 financial results.

candidate_sentences.text: For the fourth quarter of 2025 specifically, revenue was 417,438 thousand euros, gross profit was 63,282 thousand euros, EBITDA was 42,604 thousand euros, operating profit was 19,842 thousand euros, and net profit was 14,141 thousand euros.

verified_key_information_units.information: Maritime transport segment saw passenger volumes fall 0.9% annually but Q4 EBITDA improved to EUR 27.6 million; Tallink sold the cargo vessel Sailor and extended the Silja Europa charter until January 2027.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report section on Maritime Transport (passenger and cargo unit volumes); Events in Q4 2025 section details Q4 maritime results and specific events (vessel sale, charter extension).

candidate_sentences.text: Maritime transport operations through Tallink Grupp carried 5,531,132 passengers in 2025, representing a 0.9% decrease year-on-year, with Tallink reporting revenue of 765.3 million euros and net profit of 17.3 million euros.

verified_key_information_units.information: Energy segment increased sales volumes by 7% to 4.8 TWh in Q4 despite lower regional consumption; Elenger secured a multi-year LNG supply agreement for 12 cargoes and expanded battery storage capacity in Latvia while planning further developments in Estonia.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025 section details Elenger sales volume increase, LNG agreement, and battery storage commissions/construction; Management Report describes regional consumption decline and seasonality.

candidate_sentences.text: In the energy segment, Elenger Grupp increased its gas and electricity sales volumes by 7% in the fourth quarter to 4.8 TWh, despite regional consumption declining by 2%, and maintained a Finnish-Baltic market share of 21%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Real estate segment advanced major infrastructure projects including Rail Baltica mainline construction (EUR 67.2 million contract ongoing until March 2028) and a 40,000 m² Depo commercial space development in Lasnamäe scheduled for completion in fall 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Real Estate Developments section in Events in Q4 2025 details Rail Baltica contract and Depo project timeline; Real estate portfolio overview table confirms project status.

candidate_sentences.text: The real estate and infrastructure segments progressed with major projects such as Rail Baltica mainline construction and commercial space development.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic expansion into agriculture accelerated with November 2025 acquisition of 100% stake in OÜ Oisu Biogaas, complementing existing biomethane production operations under OÜ Infortar Agro.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025 section states 'In November, Infortar announced the acquisition of a 100% stake in OÜ Oisu Biogaas.'; Supporting Sectors section describes agriculture consolidation under OÜ Infortar Agro.

candidate_sentences.text: Additionally, the group expanded its agricultural footprint by acquiring a 100% stake in OÜ Oisu Biogaas in November 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity strengthened with cash rising to EUR 219.8 million and net debt/EBITDA improving to 3.6x from 4.0x, driven by debt repayments and stable operating cash flows.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures table shows cash at end of period (219,771 thousand EUR vs 167,579 thousand EUR) and net debt/EBITDA ratios; Cash Flow Statement highlights operating cash flow generation and debt repayment activities.

candidate_sentences.text: Net debt improved to 840,682 thousand euros from 1,055,708 thousand euros, bringing the net debt to EBITDA ratio down to 3.6 from 4.0.

Prudent leverage reduction, robust liquidity with cash and cash equivalents ending the year at 219,771 thousand euros, and portfolio diversification across maritime transport, energy, real estate, and agriculture contributed to steady cash flows and an improved financial footing for the future.

verified_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting events include extension of EUR 27 million loans maturing in 2026 to 2031 and Elenger Grupp's February 2026 acquisition of subsidiary SIA Mood Deco.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 14 (Events after the Reporting Date) details loan extension and Elenger acquisition announced on February 2, 2026.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4, K5, K6, and K7 are fully represented with supporting sentences covering core financial performance, quarterly results, energy segment details, real estate projects, agricultural expansion, and liquidity improvements. K3 is partially present as it covers the passenger volume decline and Q4 EBITDA improvement for maritime transport and mentions Tallink, but omits details about the cargo vessel sale and Silja Europa charter extension, which are core material components of the criterion. K8 is missing entirely as there is no mention of post-reporting loan extensions or the SIA Mood Deco acquisition. The overall coverage is strong with only one fully missing criterion and one partially covered criterion, placing the summary in the 'Generally yes' category.

coherence_issues.description: Sentence S5 states that net profit decreased from 193,670 thousand euros to 71,969 thousand euros, but then states that net profit attributable to the owners of the parent increased to 72,662 thousand euros. This creates a logical gap because the summary does not explain the relationship between these two figures or reconcile the apparent discrepancy.

candidate_sentences.text: Net profit for the financial year was 71,969 thousand euros, down from 193,670 thousand euros reported in 2024, with net profit attributable to the owners of the parent amounting to 72,662 thousand euros compared to 191,253 thousand euros in the prior year.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a logical flow of information about financial performance, balance sheet metrics, and segment operations. Explanations for changes (e.g., one-off effects in S11, inventory management in S12) are provided where needed. However, S5 contains a logical gap between the decrease in net profit and the increase in net profit attributable to parent owners without clarification. There are no self-contradictions, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. The arithmetic differences between segment and consolidated figures are not contradictions because the summary does not claim they are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
